datenschutz.title: Privacy Policy
datenschutz.description: Information on the protection of your personal data in accordance with GDPR.
datenschutz.s2Title: 2. Collection and Storage of Personal Data
datenschutz.s2Text1: We only collect and store personal data if you provide it to us voluntarily, for example through our contact form, when booking a tour, or when subscribing to our newsletter.
datenschutz.s2Text2: Data collected includes: name, email address, phone number (optional), and voluntarily provided message content.
datenschutz.s3Text: We use your data exclusively to process your inquiries, to carry out bookings, and to send our newsletter (only with explicit consent).
datenschutz.s4Text: Processing is based on Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR (consent) and Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR (contract performance).
datenschutz.s5Text: We do not share your data with third parties unless required for contract performance (e.g., to hotel or transfer partners) or unless we are legally obliged to do so.
datenschutz.s6Text: Our website only uses technically necessary cookies for website operation. No tracking or marketing cookies are used.
datenschutz.s7Text: You have the right to access, rectify, erase and restrict the processing of your personal data. You may also object to processing at any time and have the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority.
datenschutz.s8Text: For questions about data protection, please contact us at info@hurghada-reiseplaner.at.
